reviews.comment: Dr. Yim is my favorite lecturer in the department. His lectures were seriously amazing and sparked my interest in health physics, and I still use much of what he taught in class in my day to day life. Homework could sometimes be tedious, but exams were very fair and a practice exam was provided

This class has been the silver lining of my semester, his lectures are amazing, incredibly interesting. Dr Yim has been around and seen a whole lot of stuff, I was never bored or uninterested in his class. However the homeworks were pretty tough, but got much better and more understandable as time went on. I would recommend this class to everyone.
Didn't take him, but I audited a class. He's such a sweetie pie. You can tell me genuinely enjoys what he's talking about. He gave me a side hug at the end of lecture. He was pretty cool.

Dr. Yim is a very knowledgeable and experienced figure in the NUEN field and learning from him has been genuinely amazing. The class is very HW heavy and searching through slides/textbook to figure them out but once you do you'll have no issues doing well on exams. We were his first class so he was figuring things out over time but did improve.
